findings.finding: The package reproducer recomputes the normalized 1426-entry rows. The older 2240-entry figures (5018706 list visits and 54514 tree visits) are inherited constants in the delivered metrics JSON; the four-row table currently does not explicitly identify that provenance. This does not affect the new kernel-checked 32961 count or source theorem.
findings.suggestion: Label the older rows as inherited and cite their exact packet/census, or include their small original-data census reproducer.

findings.finding: The O(N log^2 N) binary-operation bound implicitly assumes query indices have O(log N) bits. The immediately preceding all-indices height bound also covers arbitrarily large out-of-range indices, whose binary arithmetic cost need not satisfy that assumption. All actual concrete queried indices are in range, so the concrete counts are unaffected.
findings.suggestion: State the bit-operation bound for in-range indices (or indices represented in O(log N) bits).

scope_notes: The 2381-byte generic module size is expressly a glue-module measure, not the total proof library.
